about.body: The Ford EcoBoost is a Inline-4 (I4), 2.0L (1,999 cc), Petrol engine used across Land Rover's 3 model range, in production 2013–2019. We rebuild every Ford EcoBoost to original specification, replacing worn timing components, bearings, gaskets and seals as standard.

byModel.body: The Ford EcoBoost is fitted across Discovery Sport, Freelander, Range Rover Evoque — see the full applications table above for exact variants, generations and years.

compatibility.body: Because the Ford EcoBoost is fitted across multiple Land Rover models, compatibility comes down to confirming your exact model, generation and specification. We confirm by registration or VIN before quoting or supplying anything.
